task.title: Decide: undo_one restoring copies into a soft-deleted collection
task.description: RULING MADE (Dylan, 2026-08-09): a plain move-undo whose target collection is soft-deleted REDIRECTS the copies to the user's Inbox — cards always come back, never silently land in a hidden collection. (Refuse and restore-the-collection were considered and rejected; the delete operation's own receipt-driven undo in step 5 is unaffected.) Being implemented alongside P6-188 on its branch, since the hole goes live the moment deletes start setting deleted_at; close this task when that PR merges. Original context: undo_one is the only write path skipping require_owned_collection (ids come from the moves ledger). Specs: specs/collection-deletion.md.
